title: District Felicitation of Dr. Bharat Pandya

photo.alt: Rotary Club members and dignitaries pose together during the District Felicitation Ceremony honouring Dr. Bharat Pandya as Rotary International President 2028–29.

summary: On 25 October 2026, Rotary District organised a special felicitation programme honouring Dr. Bharat Pandya on his election as Rotary International President for 2028–29.
description: On 25 October 2026, Rotary District organised a special felicitation programme honouring Dr. Bharat Pandya on his election as Rotary International President for 2028–29. Several members of Rotary Club of Deonar attended the occasion. Our club member, PRID T. N. Subramanian, served as the Convenor of the event, bringing together Rotarians to celebrate this significant milestone for Rotary.
